name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: State-directed Russian operations executing physical maritime drone strikes in the Black Sea, mass kinetic missile assaults against Kyiv's energy grid, and base construction for Geran-5 drones in Rostov.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 and secondary opportunists weaponizing CVE-2026-104935 to bypass authentication and gain root persistence across perimeter gateways, triggering red alerts from CISA and NBSZ NKI.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Targeted manipulation of retail cold-chain architecture spanning Danfoss, Emerson Copeland, and Dixell controllers, causing spoilage and physical fires across ~700 supermarkets in France.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Zero-click targeted advertising exploits operated via Discover-Tech delivering Candiru spyware onto high-profile targets across NATO, IAEA, and media institutions.

name: Storm-2990 Global Phishing Kit Syndicate
summary: Chinese-speaking developer syndicate operating YAM Store, Iron Man System, and CoGUI, responsible for distributing over 1 billion credential-harvesting messages worldwide.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Extortion campaign targeting 38 shipping terminal operators and logistics providers via an exposed shared enterprise portal, threatening public disclosure of operational EDI message feeds.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Large-scale compromise of 1,900 developer accounts targeting over 30,000 GitHub repositories to exfiltrate active cloud tokens, CI secrets, and deployment keys.
